description: Genetic determinants of competitive fitness in antibiotic-free medium.
Content
Effects of gene repression on competitive fitness in antibiotic-free MH medium, including effect sizes, p values and calls for reduced or increased fitness.
Membership of {{n_membership}} PAO1 genes in the negative-fitness set identified here and the three published reference sets (Fig. 2D).
Numbers of genes tested and showing reduced or increased fitness in each of the five comparisons in antibiotic-free MH medium.
Gene vulnerability to repression in antibiotic-free MH medium, summarized across four T1 comparisons, one per batch. B1 T2 is excluded.
Negative: raw Stouffer p < {{p_stouffer}} and medLFC ≤ −{{lfc_cut}}. Positive: raw p < {{p_stouffer}} and medLFC ≥ {{lfc_cut}}. Calls include T1 versus T0 in B1–B4 and T2 versus T0 in B1.
medLFC is the median control-adjusted log₂ fold change of full-match guides. Negative means depletion; positive means enrichment.
Poulsen et al. (2019) core-essential set; Zhang et al. (2025) PA14 CRISPRi set mapped to PAO1; Kaczmarczyk et al. (2025) PAO1 shared-fitness set; and this-study negative-fitness union.
